title.narrative: Improved governance of labour migration and mobility in line with ILS in Guyana

description.narrative:
This programme supports Guyana in strengthening labour migration governance to ensure that labour mobility contributes to decent work, fair recruitment, and inclusive economic development. As Guyanaâ€™s rapid economic expansion (driven in part by the oil and gas sector) creates significant labour and skills shortages, the initiative aims to help national institutions manage labour migration in an orderly, rights-based, and evidence-informed manner.
Aligned with the Guyana Decent Work Country Programme (DWCP) 2025â€“2030 and ILO Programme and Budget Outcome 6: Protection at work for all, the programme provides technical assistance, training, and policy support to strengthen legal and institutional protections for migrant workers, improve fair recruitment practices, and enhance labour market information systems. Through tripartite dialogue and regional cooperation, including alignment with CARICOM frameworks, the initiative seeks to reduce risks of labour exploitation, improve labour matching, and ensure that both migrant and national workers benefit from safe, fair, and productive employment in Guyanaâ€™s transforming economy.
